provenance: MassBank-data release 2026.03, full corpus, parsed 2026-09-07 on Python 3.9 / Windows

joinability.note: records without a well-formed InChIKey cannot be assessed for structural coverage; this is the ceiling on any coverage measurement over this library

distinct_compounds.note: libraries hold many spectra per compound (adducts, collision energies, instruments), so record count overstates compound coverage

natural_products.note: MassBank CH$COMPOUND_CLASS only; 53% of records leave the field N/A, so this is a FLOOR not an estimate
